record.question: In which year the American Hospital Association discussed Medical Record for the first time at a convention?
record.explanation: Answer A: 1902. A historical account of medical-record development reports that the American Hospital Association discussed medical records at its 1902 convention. Source/context note: Historical source is a retrospective account. Reference: https://www.um.edu.mt/library/oar/bitstream/123456789/43616/1/Chest-piece%2C_3%282%29_-_A7.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
